questions.question: 11. Which of the following is an advantage of using switch over if-else ladders in C?

answers.a: Switch is always faster for all cases.
answers.b: Switch allows multi-way branching with constant time lookup for many cases.
answers.c: Switch can handle floating point cases.

explanations.a: Incorrect. Switch is not always faster, but is generally faster for many cases due to jump tables.
explanations.b: Correct. Switch allows multi-way branching with constant time lookup for many cases.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Switch cannot handle floating point cases.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Switch is not used for loops.
